list.name: harness
list.label: Harness
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT harness FROM agent_turns ORDER BY harness

panels.title: Tokens over time by canonical bucket

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (ts_unix / 3600) * 3600 AS time, SUM(input_tokens) AS "fresh input", SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS "cache read", SUM(cache_write_tokens) AS "cache write", SUM(output_tokens) AS "output" FROM agent_turns WHERE ts_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND harness IN ($harness) AND $strict GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Usage by model x harness x reasoning effort

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT harness, model, COALESCE(reasoning_effort, '(unrecorded)') AS effort, COUNT(*) AS turns, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, SUM(input_tokens) AS fresh_input, SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read, SUM(output_tokens) AS output, SUM(prompt_tokens + output_tokens) AS observed_tokens FROM agent_turns WHERE ts_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND harness IN ($harness) AND $strict GROUP BY harness, model, effort ORDER BY observed_tokens DESC

SELECT (ts_unix / 3600) * 3600 AS time, harness, 1.0 * SUM(cache_read_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS cache_hit_ratio FROM agent_turns WHERE ts_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND harness IN ($harness) AND $strict GROUP BY time, harness ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sessions, turns and tools by harness

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT harness, client, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, COUNT(*) AS turns, SUM(tool_calls) AS tool_calls, SUM(tool_errors) AS tool_errors FROM agent_turns WHERE ts_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND harness IN ($harness) AND $strict GROUP BY harness, client ORDER BY turns DESC

panels.title: Usage by event kind (nested tool LLM calls, compaction)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT harness, event_kind, COUNT(*) AS turns, SUM(prompt_tokens + output_tokens) AS observed_tokens FROM agent_turns WHERE ts_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND harness IN ($harness) AND $strict GROUP BY harness, event_kind ORDER BY observed_tokens DESC

panels.title: Evidence basis (observed vs derived vs estimated)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT harness, usage_semantics, usage_basis, COUNT(*) AS turns, SUM(prompt_tokens + output_tokens) AS observed_tokens FROM agent_turns WHERE ts_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY harness, usage_semantics, usage_basis ORDER BY turns DESC
